title: Midnight Snack
paragraphs: Inspired by Philip Wilson Steer's Hydrangeas, this painting captures a quiet, seemingly mundane moment: a girl and her cat in the cool glow of an open refrigerator late at night. Loose, bold brushstrokes disrupt realism and give the scene a dreamlike quality, while exaggerated contrasts between cool blues and bright yellows create visual tension. Beneath the surface, the girl's simple search becomes a metaphor for introspection and the unspoken needs that surface only in solitude.
